highlights.text: Founded and ran Fox Mountain Camping Park, Morristown
Farmer and businessman: hogs, beef, crops, apples, Christmas trees and firewood; also a carpenter who cut and milled logs
Member of the Hog Producers of Nova Scotia, the Christmas Tree Farmers Association, the Cat and Coonhound Club, and the Aylesford Fire Commission

Founded Fox Mountain Camping Park, 6128 Aylesford Road, Aylesford, in 1994 after running a hog farm and Christmas tree operation; started the Fox Mountain Bluegrass Festival and ran it for 20 years (park's own history, confirmed in substance by his obituary).
